sloka: राज्ञो हलमुखोत्कृष्टा पुनरप्युत्थिता सती ।सैषा जनकराजस्य प्रसूता तनया प्रभो ।तव भार्या महाबाहो विष्णुस्त्वं हि सनातनः ।। ७.१७.३९ ॥
transliteration: rājño halamukhotkṛṣṭā punarapyutthitā satī ।saiṣā janakarājasya prasūtā tanayā prabho ।tava bhāryā mahābāho viṣṇustvaṁ hi sanātanaḥ ।। 7.17.39 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, having heard this, Ravana threw her into the water, and she, having reached the earth, indeed went into the middle of a sacrificial ground.
